exact: negative regulation of nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, meiosis-specific transcripts

definition: Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of selective degradation of meiosis-specific nuclear transcribed transcripts during vegetative growth, by a mechanism that requires determinant of selective removal (DSR) sequences in the targeted mRNAs and involves a YTH family protein.
label: negative regulation of nuclear mRNA surveillance of meiosis-specific transcripts
